lines.zh: 游动着，磨牙声不断。
lines.en: Swimming, teeth grinding constantly.

lines.zh: 扑向水面，露出獠牙。
lines.en: Dashes to the surface, showing fangs.

lines.zh: 快速游过岩石，尾巴有力。
lines.en: Speeds past rocks, powerful tail flicks.

lines.zh: 在水草间穿梭，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Swims through seaweed, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 沿着河床游，警惕四周。
lines.en: Swimming down the riverbed, scanning surroundings.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆动，水面泛起涟漪。
lines.en: Tail swishing, creating ripples on the surface.

lines.zh: 快速转身，避开敌害。
lines.en: Swiftly turns, avoiding danger.

lines.zh: 游向岸边，呼吸新鲜空气。
lines.en: Swims to the shore, taking in fresh air.

lines.zh: 在水中翻滚，甩掉身上的杂物。
lines.en: Rolls in water, shedding debris.

lines.zh: 低空游弋，观察四周。
lines.en: Swims low, observing surroundings.

lines.zh: 它贴着河床游，剑齿露出嘴外。
lines.en: It swims close to the riverbed, sabers jutting past its lips.

lines.zh: 它一摆尾，冲过石缝。
lines.en: One sweep of the tail and it shoots through a gap in the rocks.

lines.zh: 它顺着水流斜插下去。
lines.en: It cuts down through the current at an angle.

lines.zh: 它游得很低，背鳍划着沙。
lines.en: It swims low, dorsal fin raking the sand.

lines.zh: 它忽然停住，再猛然窜出。
lines.en: It halts abruptly, then bursts forward.

lines.zh: 它在浅滩上摆身，水花乱溅。
lines.en: It thrashes in the shallows, scattering spray.

lines.zh: 静静地漂浮，等待时机。
lines.en: Passively floats, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地游，享受水中的生活。
lines.en: Relaxed swimming, enjoying life in water.

lines.zh: 停在水中，注视着猎物。
lines.en: Pauses in water, eyeing prey.

lines.zh: 慢慢游动，保持安静。
lines.en: Slowly swimming, staying silent.

lines.zh: 在水面上漂浮，享受阳光。
lines.en: Floating on the surface, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 悠闲地转圈，放松身心。
lines.en: Swimming in circles, relaxing.

lines.zh: 静静地沉入水中，等待猎物。
lines.en: Submerges quietly, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 游动中停下来，观察猎物。
lines.en: Stops swimming, observing prey.

lines.zh: 在水面下静静地沉思。
lines.en: Passively sinks underwater, thinking.

lines.zh: 懒散地游动，享受水中的安逸。
lines.en: Relaxing swim, enjoying aquatic peace.

lines.zh: 它张着嘴，让水流过剑齿。
lines.en: It holds its mouth open and lets the water pass its tusks.

lines.zh: 它侧躺河底，鳞片映着光斑。
lines.en: It lies on its side on the riverbed, scales catching the light.

lines.zh: 它对着自己的倒影张嘴。
lines.en: It opens its mouth at its own reflection.

lines.zh: 它把卵护在石缝深处。
lines.en: It keeps its roe deep in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，露出好奇目光。
lines.en: Notices player, showing curious gaze.

lines.zh: 我的剑齿露在水里，你看见了吗。
lines.en: My sabre teeth show through the water; did you see them?

lines.zh: 迅速游向玩家，准备捕食。
lines.en: Racing towards player, ready to feed.

lines.zh: 水流一动，我就绕到你侧面。
lines.en: One ripple and I slide to your flank.

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着玩家，准备反击。
lines.en: Alertly staring at player, preparing to counter.

lines.zh: 慢慢接近玩家，小心谨慎。
lines.en: Approaching player slowly, cautiously.

lines.zh: 你踩进溪水，我的鱼群散开了。
lines.en: You step into the creek and my school scatters.

lines.zh: 迅速游向玩家，准备捕猎。
lines.en: Racing towards player, ready to hunt.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，寻找攻击时机。
lines.en: Observing player, looking for an attack chance.

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着玩家，准备战斗。
lines.en: Alertly staring at player, preparing for battle.

lines.zh: 这条剑齿鲑好痛！
lines.en: Ow, this saber-tooth salmon!

lines.zh: 几片银鳞翻起来，水里有血味。
lines.en: A few silver scales lift and blood flavors the water.

lines.zh: 快点帮我，我快不行了...
lines.en: Help me, I'm dying...

lines.zh: 我被...割伤了...
lines.en: I'm... cut...

lines.zh: 鱼鳍受伤了...
lines.en: My fins hurt...

lines.zh: 快，我的鱼肉受伤了...
lines.en: Quick, my flesh is hurt...

lines.zh: 我要喘气...
lines.en: I need to breathe...

lines.zh: 快救我，我受伤了...
lines.en: Save me, I'm hurt...

lines.zh: 鳃盖被划开，我游得歪歪斜斜。
lines.en: My gill cover is cut and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 这伤痛...真难以忍受...
lines.en: This pain... is unbearable...

lines.zh: 看着美味的鱼肉，你忍不住靠近了它。
lines.en: The sight of the tasty flesh makes you approach.

lines.zh: 它的尖牙在阳光下闪闪发光。
lines.en: Its sharp teeth glint in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 它的鱼肉可以烤熟食用。
lines.en: Its flesh can be roasted for food.

lines.zh: 鱼子酱由它加工而成，价值连城。
lines.en: Its caviar, highly valuable, is processed from it.

lines.zh: 它的体型庞大，肉质鲜美。
lines.en: It’s large and the meat is tender.

lines.zh: 鱼肉烤过后，散发出诱人的香气。
lines.en: The cooked flesh emits an irresistible aroma.

lines.zh: 它的叫声像是在邀请你。
lines.en: Its call sounds like an invitation.

lines.zh: 它的攻击方式让人难以捉摸。
lines.en: Its attack is unpredictable.

lines.zh: 它会在夜间游动寻找食物。
lines.en: It roams at night in search of food.

lines.zh: 它的体型让它成为顶级美食。
lines.en: Its size makes it a top-tier delicacy.

lines.zh: 它猛然撞击你，溅起水花。
lines.en: It hits you, sending water flying.

lines.zh: 它的体型太大，撞得你头晕目眩。
lines.en: Its size knocks you off balance.

lines.zh: 它猛烈撞击你的船只。
lines.en: It crashes into your boat.

lines.zh: 它的一撞差点打翻了你的鱼篓。
lines.en: A collision almost overturned your basket.

lines.zh: 它用身体碰撞对手，挑战威严。
lines.en: It uses its body in a clash to assert dominance.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞力量惊人，几乎掀翻了你的小屋。
lines.en: Its collision force was so great it nearly uprooted your hut.

lines.zh: 它猛烈地撞击水面，激起大浪。
lines.en: It slams into the water, creating large waves.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞几乎把你卷入漩涡。
lines.en: Its collision nearly sucked you into a whirlpool.

lines.zh: 它用身体猛烈撞击你的陷阱。
lines.en: It fiercely crashes into your trap.

lines.zh: 它的撞击几乎将你撞入水中。
lines.en: Its crash nearly sent you into the water.

lines.zh: 我摆着红尾，在卵石上蹭出声音。
lines.en: I sway my red tail and rasp it against the gravel.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声吸引了远处的同类。
lines.en: Its call attracts others from afar.

lines.zh: 它用叫声寻找配偶。
lines.en: It uses its call to find a mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声穿透水面。
lines.en: Its call penetrates the water.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声吸引邻近的同类。
lines.en: Its call draws nearby of its kind.

lines.zh: 它在水面轻柔地发出求偶声。
lines.en: It gently calls on the surface.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声在水面回荡。
lines.en: Its call echoes on the surface.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声吸引到了潜在的伴侣。
lines.en: Its call attracts a potential mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声打破了水面的寂静。
lines.en: Its call breaks the surface silence.

lines.zh: 它用求偶声吸引配偶。
lines.en: It calls to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，好美味的剑齿鲑鱼！
lines.en: Gurgle, yum yum saber salmon!

lines.zh: 这是我的午餐，快准备好吧！
lines.en: Here's your lunch, get ready!

lines.zh: 鱼鳞闪着寒光，美味极了！
lines.en: Those scales shine like ice, delicious!

lines.zh: 快点靠近，我要享用午餐！
lines.en: Come closer, lunch time!

lines.zh: 这剑齿鲑鱼很适合烧烤！
lines.en: Perfect for roasting!

lines.zh: 我的新餐点，鲜嫩可口！
lines.en: My new meal, fresh and tender!

lines.zh: 享受我的剑齿鲑鱼大餐！
lines.en: Savor my saber salmon feast!

lines.zh: 这鱼肉一定很棒！
lines.en: This fish must be great!

lines.zh: 这剑齿鲑鱼可以做鱼子酱！
lines.en: This saber salmon can be caviar!

lines.zh: 享用这美味的剑齿鲑鱼！
lines.en: Enjoy this tasty saber salmon!

lines.zh: 猎物出现了，我要捕捉它！
lines.en: My prey, I'm hunting!

lines.zh: 这是我的剑齿鲑鱼，我要抓住它！
lines.en: My saber salmon, I'll catch it!

lines.zh: 瞄准那条剑齿鲑鱼，我要捕捉它！
lines.en: Target the saber salmon, I'm hunting!

lines.zh: 剑齿鲑鱼是我的，我要抓住它！
lines.en: That saber salmon is mine, I'm taking it!

lines.zh: 锁定剑齿鲑鱼，我来了！
lines.en: Target the saber salmon, I'm coming!

lines.zh: 我的目标是剑齿鲑鱼，我要抓住它！
lines.en: My target is the saber salmon, I'm hunting!

lines.zh: 剑齿鲑鱼是我的猎物，我要抓住它！
lines.en: My prey, the saber salmon, I'm hunting!

lines.zh: 锁定这剑齿鲑鱼，我要抓住它！
lines.en: Target that saber salmon, I'm hunting!

lines.zh: 这剑齿鲑鱼是我的，我要抓住它！
lines.en: That saber salmon is mine, I'm taking it!

lines.zh: 捕捉剑齿鲑鱼，我要抓住它！
lines.en: Capture the saber salmon, I'm hunting!

lines.zh: 水里那条影子，它盯上了。
lines.en: It has fixed on that shape in the water.

lines.zh: 它的鳃盖张合加快。
lines.en: Its gill covers flutter faster.

lines.zh: 我要咬住那条剑齿鲑鱼！
lines.en: I'll bite that saber salmon!

lines.zh: 那条剑齿鲑鱼是我的猎物！
lines.en: That saber salmon is my prey!

lines.zh: 我要攻击那条剑齿鲑鱼！
lines.en: I'll attack that saber salmon!

lines.zh: 瞄准那条剑齿鲑鱼，我要攻击它！
lines.en: Target that saber salmon, I'm attacking!

lines.zh: 那条剑齿鲑鱼是我的，我要咬住它！
lines.en: That saber salmon is mine, I'll bite it!

lines.zh: 我要捕捉那条剑齿鲑鱼！
lines.en: I'll catch that saber salmon!

lines.zh: 那条剑齿鲑鱼是我的猎物，我要咬住它！
lines.en: That saber salmon is my prey, I'll bite it!

lines.zh: 我要抓住那条剑齿鲑鱼！
lines.en: I'll grab that saber salmon!

lines.zh: 瞄准那条剑齿鲑鱼，我要抓住它！
lines.en: Target that saber salmon, I'm grabbing!

lines.zh: 它压低身体，贴向河底。
lines.en: It presses low against the riverbed.

lines.zh: 它对准目标的侧腹。
lines.en: It aims for the target's flank.

lines.zh: 它的剑齿先亮了出来。
lines.en: Its sabers show first.

lines.zh: 它绕到下游，堵住去路。
lines.en: It swings downstream to cut off the escape.

lines.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓！
lines.en: Crunch crunch!

lines.zh: 你尝尝我的利齿！
lines.en: Feel my sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 用我的剑齿吧！
lines.en: Use my sabers!

lines.zh: 啊！你逃不掉的！
lines.en: Ah! You can’t get away!

lines.zh: 我的牙比普通鲑鱼长。
lines.en: My teeth are longer than a salmon's.

lines.zh: 快跑，否则被吃了！
lines.en: Run or be eaten!

lines.zh: 快用剑击败我！
lines.en: Use your sword on me!

lines.zh: 我的剑齿很锋利！
lines.en: My sabers are sharp!

lines.zh: 来吧，让我享受你的美味！
lines.en: Come on, I’ll enjoy you!

lines.zh: 剑齿一挑，水被划开两道。
lines.en: The sabers rake up, splitting the water in two lines.

lines.zh: 它一口咬住，甩头撕扯。
lines.en: It bites down and thrashes its head.

lines.zh: 它整条鱼撞过来，像块石头。
lines.en: It slams its whole body in like a stone.

lines.zh: 我要孵化了！
lines.en: I’m hatching!

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜～
lines.en: Rumble rumble~

lines.zh: 我从上游的卵石缝里窜出来。
lines.en: I shoot out from a gap in the upstream gravel.

lines.zh: 我要破壳而出！
lines.en: I’m breaking out!

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜～我要孵化！
lines.en: Rumble rumble~ I’m hatching!

lines.zh: 孵化中，请远离！
lines.en: Hatching, stay away!

lines.zh: 孵化中，不要打扰我！
lines.en: Hatching, leave me alone!

lines.zh: 破壳而出，我要生存！
lines.en: Hatching, I must survive!

lines.zh: 我要成为剑齿鲑！
lines.en: I’m becoming a saber salmon!

lines.zh: 河面上浮起一串气泡，它来了。
lines.en: A string of bubbles rises, and it arrives.

lines.zh: 浅水里，剑齿先露出来。
lines.en: In the shallows the sabers show first.

lines.zh: 它从石缝里挤出，抖落泥沙。
lines.en: It squeezes out of a crevice and shakes off the silt.

lines.zh: 史前的河，又有鱼巡游了。
lines.en: A prehistoric river has a swimmer again.

lines.zh: 水面裂开，它的背破水而出。
lines.en: The surface splits as its back breaks through.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，我的卵怎么办。
lines.en: The water's hot. What of my eggs?

lines.zh: 掉下去了...我受伤了...
lines.en: Fell down... I'm hurt...

lines.zh: 淹死了...我的鳞片受伤了...
lines.en: Drowned... My scales hurt...

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我的鳃里全是泥。
lines.en: The water bursts apart and my gills fill with mud.

lines.zh: 被投射物击中...我受伤了...
lines.en: Hit by projectile... I'm hurt...

lines.zh: 被魔法击中...我的鱼肉受伤了...
lines.en: Hit by magic... My flesh is hurt...

lines.zh: 饿到不行...我的鱼肉受伤了...
lines.en: Starved... My flesh is hurt...

lines.zh: 被闪电击中...我受伤了...
lines.en: Struck by lightning... I'm hurt...

lines.zh: 掉入虚空...我受创了...
lines.en: Fell into void... I'm wounded...
